text:
Anselm Reyes has been named the new conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, the orchestra's board announced on 14 March 2025.

Reyes signed a five-year contract and will take the podium at the start of the 2025-26 season. He was chosen from a shortlist of 31 candidates.

The decision followed a closed-session vote by the board. Its official press release was read aloud at a press conference at Calder Hall.

Marguerite Oyelaran, chair of the Halewyn Philharmonic board, led the selection committee and made the announcement.

"The committee weighed every candidate with great care, and Anselm Reyes was the clear choice for the orchestra's next chapter," Oyelaran said.

The appointment ends the search for a new musical leader for the orchestra. Further details on Reyes's first season are expected to be released by the board in the coming months.
